words.sourceMeaning: 비경합적인 (한 사람이 사용해도 다른 사람의 사용이 줄지 않는 성질. rival '경쟁자'에서 온 말)

meanings.en: Describing a good whose use by one person does not reduce its availability to others.
meanings.wrongEn: Describing a good that can be used up by only one person at a time.

meanings.en: A statement that someone firmly says is true.
meanings.wrongEn: A question asked to get more information.

words.sourceMeaning: 독특한, 특유의 ('이상한'이라는 뜻도 있지만 여기서는 데이터만의 고유한 성질)

meanings.en: Belonging specifically to one particular thing; distinctive.
meanings.wrongEn: Shared equally by everything of the same kind.
